headline: JNK India Limited: Monitoring Agency Report on IPO Proceeds Utilisation (Q1 FY27)
sum: CRISIL Ratings issued a monitoring agency report for JNK India Limited's IPO proceeds utilisation for the quarter ended 30 June 2026. The filing is a regulatory compliance document pursuant to SEBI LODR and ICDR rules requiring periodic disclosure of capital deployment post-listing.
implication: Mandatory monitoring-agency reporting under SEBI LODR Reg 32(6) and ICDR Reg 41 is a standard gate in Indian public-company governance; the timing and completeness of utilisation disclosures can trigger investor and regulator scrutiny if material commitments slip.
detail: JNK India Limited filed a monitoring agency report dated 13 August 2026, certified by CRISIL Ratings Limited, covering the quarter ended 30 June 2026 (Q1 FY27). The report tracks deployment of IPO capital against the objects stated in the company's offer document. SEBI requires listed companies to appoint an independent monitoring agency and file quarterly progress reports under LODR Reg 32(6) and ICDR Reg 41, with disclosure to the stock exchange (here, NSE). This is a standard post-IPO governance checkpoint; the report itself does not disclose individual utilisation figures in the headline, but is lodged as a formal regulatory filing.

framework.note: Requires monitoring of utilisation of capital raised via IPO; monitoring agency to file quarterly/annual reports with stock exchange and company.
Mandates disclosure by listed companies of utilisation of proceeds from capital issuances; tied to monitoring-agency certification.
Sets out objects of the issue and basis for allocation of proceeds; forms the benchmark against which monitoring-agency report measures deployment.
Governs issuance of shares by listed public company; provides statutory framework for capital raises including IPO.
Post-issue obligations: disclosure timelines, monitoring-agency role, annual certification, investor communications.

conditions: Quarterly monitoring-agency certification of IPO proceeds utilisation
Compliance with objects stated in offer document
Filing with stock exchange (NSE) within prescribed timeline post quarter-end
approvals: NSE (receipt and acceptance of monitoring-agency report)

triggers.note: Mandatory monitoring-agency reporting post-IPO; CRISIL appointed as independent certifier.
